title: Validate entire build
description:
[Plan update — operator constraint]: Validate the flat 192.168.1.0/24 network with Proxmox firewall security-group enforcement (management/media/game/ai/dmz) instead of VLAN segmentation.

[Plan update — operator constraint]: Add validation that defrusciohomelab.duckdns.org resolves, TLS certs are issued, and each service is reachable over public HTTPS through the dmz security group (tcp 80/443).

[Plan update — operator constraint]: Validate the actual deployment: Tailscale running directly on the Proxmox host (pve, 100.84.253.90) advertising 192.168.1.0/24 subnet routes, rather than a dedicated container/VM.

[Plan update — operator constraint]: Reframe T37 to first repair the broken components (rebuild the Caddyfile in LXC 120 and restart it, start the control-panel backend on 3001) before running the validation checks, or split into a repair step followed by validation.

[Plan update — operator constraint]: Drop the repair-first reframing and proceed directly to the validation checks (firewall security-group enforcement, DNS resolution, TLS issuance, and per-service public HTTPS reachability), noting that the Caddyfile and control-panel backend are already repaired and running.

[Plan update — operator constraint]: Validation of security-group enforcement will fail because the groups directory/files don't exist; T37 must first ensure the groups are created (or explicitly validate their absence and creation) before asserting enforcement.
